title: 💰 expenses sync
body:
# 🧭 Steps

1. Run the monthly expenses routine: read pool balances, distribute income, top up when low, run recharges, reconcile.

Private instruction (not public): https://github.com/kapetim/private/blob/main/src/finance/expenses.md

## ✅ Done when

- Every pool checked against its target
- Recharges done — no duplicate subscriptions
- Card and credit policy reconciled
